mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_im_broadcast_setting_history ( setting_id, shop_id, version_no, change_type, change_source, enabled, week_days, repeat_mode, send_time, content, operator_user_id, operator_name, before_snapshot_json, after_snapshot_json, create_time ) VALUES ( #{settingId}, #{shopId}, #{versionNo}, #{changeType}, #{changeSource}, #{enabled}, #{weekDays}, #{repeatMode}, #{sendTime}, #{content}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{beforeSnapshotJson}, #{afterSnapshotJson}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, setting_id, shop_id, version_no, change_type, change_source, enabled, week_days, repeat_mode, send_time, content, operator_user_id, operator_name, before_snapshot_json, after_snapshot_json, create_time FROM mt_im_broadcast_setting_history WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
